physicalNotes: Radius 0.26325181 Jupiter radii from Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract): 18,820.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.06135386 Jupiter masses (Polanski et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
